snippet.title: Bunny Haven: Official Launch Trailer | Out NOW on the App Store and Google Play
snippet.description:
Just in time for Easter, Bunny Haven is OUT NOW!  Hop into this irresistibly cute bunny game, where you're in charge of a bunny rescue sanctuary. Your mission is to adopt and pamper adorable rescue bunnies, transform your garden into their loving haven, manage a cozy cafe, and play matchmaker for customers and their bunny friends.

🌸 Download FREE on the App Store and Google Play: https://onelink.to/runawaybunnyhaven
